classification.difficultyReason: Direct calculation of three summary statistics from two numerical data sets.

content.prompt: Find the mean, median and range of each of the following sets of data. Give any non-terminating or longer decimal answer correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
In ascending order: $21,\ 34,\ 34,\ 45,\ 45,\ 56,\ 67,\ 89$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Mean}&=\frac{34+45+67+89+45+56+34+21}{8}\\\text{Mean}&=\frac{391}{8}\\\text{Mean}&=48.875\\\text{Mean}&\approx48.88\end{align*}$$
The middle values are the fourth and fifth values, both $45$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{45+45}{2}\\\text{Median}&=45\\\text{Range}&=89-21\\\text{Range}&=68\end{align*}$$

In ascending order: $11,\ 21,\ 23,\ 24,\ 43,\ 45,\ 56,\ 61,\ 78,\ 562$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Mean}&=\frac{11+23+24+45+61+43+21+56+78+562}{10}\\\text{Mean}&=\frac{924}{10}\\\text{Mean}&=92.4\end{align*}$$
The middle values are the fifth and sixth values, $43$ and $45$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{43+45}{2}\\\text{Median}&=44\\\text{Range}&=562-11\\\text{Range}&=551\end{align*}$$
